name: save-clear
description: End-of-session ritual: Claude saves memory and a verified session summary, clears the context by itself, and the next session starts from the summary.

snapshot_dir.title: Snapshot folder
snapshot_dir.description: Where session summaries and compaction safety nets are written. Empty = ~/.claude/snapshots

notify_command.title: Notify command (optional)
notify_command.description: Program called with one line of text when the automatic /clear succeeds, fails or is refused (e.g. a script that sends you a push message). Empty = no notifications.

publish_link.title: Publish the summary as a link (optional)
publish_link.description: on: when the Artifact tool is available, the skill publishes the summary as a private claude.ai page and the next session shows the link first. Useful from a phone, where /clear wipes the screen.

context_cap_tokens.title: Context limit for an automatic save-clear (tokens)
context_cap_tokens.description: When the context passes this many tokens, Claude runs save-clear at the end of the turn. Empty = 300000 (30% of a 1M window). 0 = off.

idle_minutes.title: Idle trigger: minutes idle before an automatic save-clear
idle_minutes.description: Used only if you scheduled the idle trigger (./install.sh --idle). A session idle this long (and under 59 min, while the 1-hour prompt cache is warm) runs save-clear by itself. Empty = 50. 0 = off.

idle_min_tokens.title: Idle trigger: smallest context worth saving (tokens)
idle_min_tokens.description: The idle trigger skips sessions with a smaller context. Empty = 80000.

language.title: Language (optional)
language.description: Language for the snapshot and the reply after the resume, e.g. Portuguese. Empty = the conversation's language.

resume_message.title: Resume request text (optional)
resume_message.description: What is typed (terminal) or sent by the relay (desktop app) right after the /clear. Empty = the built-in English request.

extra_steps.title: Extra steps for the ritual (optional)
extra_steps.description: Your own instructions the skill follows during the save (text, or the path of a file that holds them). Example: call a tool before clear_session.

on_save_command.title: Command run at save time (optional)
on_save_command.description: Runs when the skill arms the resume, with SAVE_CLEAR_SNAPSHOT set. What it prints is appended to the snapshot.

pre_clear_command.title: Command run right before /clear (optional)
pre_clear_command.description: Runs just before the automatic /clear (terminal) or clear_session (desktop app). Gets SAVE_CLEAR_SESSION_ID, SAVE_CLEAR_MODE, SAVE_CLEAR_TARGET. Never stops the clear.

on_resume_command.title: Command run on resume (optional)
on_resume_command.description: Runs after the /clear, when the summary is delivered, with SAVE_CLEAR_SNAPSHOT set. What it prints (exit 0) is added to the new session's context.
